name: Weight Training
description: General resistance-training guidance for healthy adults: learn the movement, train with control, and progress gradually.

steps.text: Warm up with easy movement before lifting.
Learn each movement with a light load and controlled form before adding weight.
Train regularly with a few movements that use large muscle groups.
Add load or repetitions gradually over time, only when form stays controlled.
Give the same muscles rest days between hard sessions.
Stop on sharp pain, chest pain or dizziness.

claims.text: Regular resistance training increases muscle strength in healthy adults.
Gradually increasing load or repetitions over time supports continued strength gains.
Rest days between hard sessions for the same muscles may help recovery.
Learning a movement with a light load before adding weight may lower the chance of injury.
A warm-up before lifting may lower the chance of injury.

safety_notes: Not medical advice. Ask a clinician before starting if you have a heart condition, high blood pressure, are pregnant, or are recovering from injury.
Stop on chest pain, fainting, dizziness or sharp joint pain and seek a clinician.
No specific loads, sets, repetitions or rest times are given until the evidence review is complete.
